correctness.rationale: The actual graph LCF [5,-5]^8 decomposes into two eight-bit shores with explicitly defined majority polynomials f and g. The source’s full 256-word tables certify h³=h² and k³=k² plus f k²=f k and g h²=g h, giving F^5=F^3, and 72 stable shore symbols on each side with f,g mutually inverse in the core. The periodic map swaps ordered pairs of 72 symbols: 72 fixed and C(72,2)=2556 genuine temporal 2-cycles. Exact retraction-fiber weights 22×1, 48×2, 2×69 yield fixed basin sizes 1(22),4(48),4761(2) and two-cycle basins 2(231),4(1056),8(1128),138(44),276(96),9522(1). The source lists twelve complete necklace reps. An independent explicit graph-level full 65,536-state enumeration, not just stored log, reproduced every orbit, basin and sharp entrance-time layer (5184,15552,22528,22272). This exhaustive finite proof covers precisely this fixed finite graph.
